messages.subject: R/qtl version 1.74
parts:
A new version of R/qtl (1.74) has been released at its website (https://rqtl.org) and on CRAN. Windows and Mac binaries will be available on CRAN within a few days.

Just some tiny changes to fix some warnings on CRAN.

Karl Broman
